title: What If The Spider Bit A Rich Kid?
description:
A spoiled rich kid gets spider powers, and uses them for all the wrong things. Then his butler needs saving... and his dad has a secret.
Who's worse, Peter or his dad? Tell me below.

Twist Tales: original animated stories, and every one ends with a twist.
lines: One day in New York, Peter Sterling got bitten by a glowing spider.
His father, Dr. Thomas Sterling, was the city's richest surgeon, famous for giving millions to hospitals.
But at home, Peter got everything he ever asked for.
By morning, Peter could climb walls, lift cars, and hear a whisper three streets away.
He stuck the school trophy to his own shelf.
He climbed straight past the queue at every club.
He swung to school just to show off his new gold sneakers.
Only one person ever told him no: Walter, the family's old butler.
Then Peter heard it. Three streets away. Walter's voice. "Help!"
Two thieves had grabbed Walter in the middle of the city's busiest crossing.
Peter swung down, shot webs at both of them, and stopped all the traffic.
The whole city filmed it. Back home, his father was waiting at the door... smiling.
*"I hired those thieves. Now our family is trending number one!"
"Walter... you're fired. You took too long to scream."
